facts.action: Inara 夜里坐在王宫最高屋顶檐边望城，摆脱不掉众人惊恐目光、自问是否邪恶；Fraener（微型形态）依偎安抚，把俯瞰战场的记忆与纯粹的 pride 推进她脑海——在它眼里她是 light 而非 darkness
facts.verbatim: Not a darkness, but a light.

facts.action: Felix 上屋顶陪坐，戳破她强装没事，称自己看见的是以身护人的强大女人，并以 best friend 身份拒绝让她相信相反；Inara 落泪，两人纯友谊相拥
facts.verbatim: I refuse to let you believe anything fucking different

facts.action: 骤然奇寒宣告 Walder 到来（ball 的红鳞甲仍被血浸透、Tydus 盯视 Inara）；Felix 假打哈欠借口困倦、吻她脸颊道别后离去
Walder 讲解魔力显化全凭血统（父母基因各半，罕见时两系融合成独有之力），并举 Larissa 为例：母 Shielder、父 Electrokinetic、三个兄弟姐妹分别显化，Larissa 融合出可注入闪电的护盾
Inara 自陈父亲是 Shielder、母亲是极强的 Clairsentient（能感知他人能力、训练 Deadhaven 居民）；Walder 称她的掌控数一数二，问 “Who said being a monster is a bad thing?”，并称刺客若落其手会遭远更惨的下场
facts.verbatim: Who said being a monster is a bad thing?

facts.action: Inara 坦白当年闯 Fraener 龙穴是为偷金子；Walder 笑称 “I knew it”，并承认自己七岁时被朋友打赌潜入 Tydus 龙穴偷 golden chalice——两人情形几乎相同，Inara 大笑
facts.verbatim: I went into that den to steal the gold

facts.action: 答第三头 Guardian 之下落：Dark War 后仅存三龙、唯一雌龙 Edora 被 High Council 强迫连窝繁殖，最终借 Tydus 与 Fraener 之助于约 1000 年前挣脱锁链远遁、从此无人再见；此事是他窥看 Tydus 记忆所得
facts.verbatim: She has not been seen since.

facts.action: Inara 以目力俯瞰发现下城集市（每月一次、乐声笑语），跳起邀 Walder 同去；Walder 以 “I-I can’t go there” 拒绝，她留下 “想来就来找我” 的话，朝集市灯光一跃而下
facts.verbatim: sighted the rays of light streaming from the markets

relations: Inara 与 Fraener：soul-link 的 Guardian；Fraener 以微型形态相伴，向她推送 pride，视她为 “a light, not a darkness”
Inara 与 Felix：best friend / “friend soulmate”，纯柏拉图式友情；两人同住一室（“I’ll meet you in our room later”）
Inara 与 Prince Walder：Overlord 与 Shielder 的上下级；屋顶夜谈后彼此更近（他认她 “not a monster”，她向他承认偷金往事）
Prince Walder 与 Tydus：七岁起 soul-link；当年同样被朋友打赌闯龙穴偷金杯
Inara 的父亲是 Shielder；母亲是极强的 Clairsentient（能感知能力、训练 Deadhaven 居民）
Larissa 家系：母亲 Shielder、父亲 Electrokinetic；三个兄弟姐妹（两个 Shielder、一个 Electrokinetic），Larissa 本人两系融合
Edora 与 Tydus、Fraener：Dark War 后仅存三龙的同伴；High Council 囚禁并强迫 Edora 繁殖，她借二龙之力逃脱
Prince Walder 对 High Council：他透过 Tydus 的记忆知晓其虐龙旧事并为之愤怒（“I saw it… When I looked through Tydus’s memories”）
numbers: You get half your genes from your mother. Half your genes from your father.（父母基因各半）
In most cases, one power is stronger than the other（通常一系占强）
Larissa has three siblings. Two of them manifested as Shielders, taking after their mother, one an Electrokinetic, like their father.（三个兄弟姐妹：两个 Shielder、一个 Electrokinetic）
Tydus and Fraener are two of The Three Guardians that survived the Dark War（Dark War 存活三守护者中的两头）
there were only three dragons left but only one female. Edora.（仅存三龙、唯一雌龙 Edora）
In one clutch, female dragons will lay up to five eggs.（一窝至多五枚蛋）
there should be at least a year between clutches（两窝之间至少隔一年）
After centuries of abuse, Edora could take no more.（数世纪虐待）
That was roughly 1000 years ago, now.（约 1000 年前）
Since I was seven.（Walder 七岁起与 Tydus soul-link）
The lower cities throw them every month.（下城集市每月一次）
The villages within the Borderlands did something similar every month.（Borderlands 集市亦每月一次）
